title: Imbalanced classification protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Imbalanced classification should complete this objective: Evaluate metrics and class-weighted models. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Improve class-level evaluation.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Compare accuracy with a class-sensitive metric and describe the positive class.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for class_weight, balanced_accuracy_score, recall_score and does not run the learner code. Compare accuracy with a class-sensitive metric and describe the positive class.
